facts.title: Blueberry Lavender Hard Lemonade
ingredients: ½ teaspoon agave nectar or simple syrup (or more, to taste)
1 ½ ounces vodka or gin (Hendrick’s suggested)
3 sprigs of fresh lavender and ⅔ cup cold water OR ⅔ cup lavender tea made with dried lavender (see instructions)
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
